CustomField.description: Written by: call 1, only on AAO_DC_N naming pairs. Read by: the join, which keys the criterion on opportunity plus this name. A CRITERION'S IDENTITY IS ITS NAME, ruled 8 August 2026 (a23, refined at the twenty-seventh stamp): a descriptive word or words stating the condition that must be true for the buyer to make the positive decision, derived from the establishing words. "Annual total cost" is the specimen. This is a derived label and not evidence: the verbatim establishing words stay on AAO_Answer_Text__c under the byte check, and this field is what the vendor Subject displays. Null on every non-naming pair. Capped at 255 because the vendor Subject holds 255 and a clipped name is a name nobody chose.
CustomField.label: Criterion Name
